title: Australian-Style Jewel-Toned Frittata
description: A vibrant and flavorful frittata recipe packed with Australian and jewel-toned ingredients, perfect for a gluten-free breakfast or brunch.
instructions: In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the diced onion and cook until translucent, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the diced bell pepper and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes.
In a large bowl, whisk together the eggs, shredded cheese, and a pinch of salt and pepper.
Pour the egg mixture over the cooked vegetables in the skillet.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 15-20 minutes, or until the frittata is set and golden brown.
Remove the skillet from the oven and sprinkle with chopped parsley.
Let the frittata rest for a few minutes before slicing and serving.
